abstract: We report the case of a malignant immature teratoma diagnosed at 21 weeks of amenorrhea in a 36-year-old healthy woman. Ultrasound examination showed a multilocular cystic mass of 175 mm in diameter, situated on the left side of the uterus. A left ovariectomy was performed by laparotomy at 22 weeks of amenorrhea. Histologic examination revealed a malignant grade 2 immature teratoma, and the patient underwent three courses of chemotherapy with a good pregnancy outcome. A cesarean section was carried out at 39 weeks of amenorrhea, associated with a left salpingectomy on which the pathologist examination did not find any malignant cells. The newborn had a normal aspect, and the mother was considered to be in remission after two more courses of chemotherapy..
abstract_ja: 症例報告：36歳の健康な女性において、妊娠21週（無月経週数）に悪性未熟奇形腫と診断された。超音波検査で、子宮左側に直径175 mmの多房性嚢胞性腫瘤を認めた。無月経22週に開腹下に左卵巣摘出術を施行した。病理組織学的検査で悪性グレード2の未熟奇形腫と診断され、患者は3コースの化学療法を受け、良好な妊娠経過をたどった。無月経39週に帝王切開を施行し、同時に左卵管切除術を行ったが、病理学的検査で悪性細胞は認められなかった。新生児は正常な外観であった。母親はさらに2コースの化学療法の後、寛解と判断された。
